purpose: Reviewable source and actual closed complete-access/retained ledgers, with all failures preserved. Huge raw waveforms/models/generated designs are excluded from Git and remain durable at hash-bound paths.
limits: No FPGA/routing proof or accepted optimization. Single negative native0 pair, no performance projection.
Raw FST and selected105/45port streams remain external; archived actual event ledgers include every accepted normal cached reference/miss/refill/eviction and retained event, not miss-only data.
Earlier capped traces are unfinalized diagnostics and are never accepted as cache/performance samples.
